messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Contact and Conversation" as it appears in the following examples.
['eBay member Giovanna has left you a message regarding item #2801119587** on Monday, 25 May, 2009.', 'Please contact me on Thanks for your anticipated cooperation.', 'PLEASE IF YOU REAL NEED TO HELP, YOU CAN REPLY ME THIS MAILS SOON AS YOU GET IT SO THAT WE WILL TALK ABOUT THE PARENTAGE(%) AND HOW WE WILL MOVE THIS MONEY TO YOUR COUNTRY.', 'Please if this proposal is acceptable to you kindly contact me through the above email address immediately for more discussion.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
